name: l2 predictions match nearest labels
input: three training points and three queries
test:
import numpy as np
X = np.array([[0.0, 0.0], [2.0, 0.0], [0.0, 3.0]])
y = np.array(['origin', 'right', 'up'])
Q = np.array([[0.1, 0.1], [1.8, 0.2], [0.2, 2.7]])
pred = predict_1nn_l2(Q, X, y)
assert pred.tolist() == ['origin', 'right', 'up']

name: linear logits select the same l2 neighbor
input: compare argmax logits with direct l2 prediction
test:
import numpy as np
X = np.array([[1.0, 1.0], [3.0, -1.0], [-2.0, 0.5]])
y = np.array([10, 20, 30])
Q = np.array([[2.5, -0.8], [-1.0, 0.4], [0.0, 0.0]])
logits = l2_distance_logits(Q, X)
assert logits.shape == (3, 3)
assert y[np.argmax(logits, axis=1)].tolist() == predict_1nn_l2(Q, X, y).tolist()

name: l1 can choose a different neighbor than l2
input: one query where l1 and l2 disagree
test:
import numpy as np
X = np.array([[0.0, 4.0], [2.2, 2.2]])
y = np.array(['axis', 'diag'])
Q = np.array([[0.0, 0.0]])
assert predict_1nn_l2(Q, X, y).tolist() == ['diag']
assert predict_1nn_l1(Q, X, y).tolist() == ['axis']

name: ties choose the first training point
input: query equally distant from two points
test:
import numpy as np
X = np.array([[0.0, 0.0], [2.0, 0.0]])
y = np.array(['first', 'second'])
Q = np.array([[1.0, 0.0]])
assert predict_1nn_l2(Q, X, y).tolist() == ['first']
assert predict_1nn_l1(Q, X, y).tolist() == ['first']
